title: Give 'Em Enough Rope
studio_context: Basing Street, London, and the Automatt, San Francisco, March-September 1978; engineered by Corky Stasiak.

drum_performances.name: Topper Headon
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first album with the band; Pearlman mixed the drums louder than the vocals throughout. Safe European Home opens it: the kick in eighths under the crashes, the outro's reggae.

notable_moments.description: Pearlman 'ensured the drums were mixed louder than Strummer's vocals on the entire album'.

evidence.note: Studios, producer and dates as Wikipedia gives them; the drums from the transcription and the record.
